const p="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Scripted, Cartesian-space controller for the frozen ALOHA peg insertion."""
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.optimize import least_squares
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+import rcb_aloha as ra
+
+s = ra.Session('/app/instance.json')
+m, d, mj = s.model, s.data, s.mj
+kd = mj.MjData(m)
+arms = ('left', 'right')
+idxs = {'left': np.arange(6), 'right': np.arange(8, 14)}
+aidxs = {'left': np.arange(6), 'right': np.arange(7, 13)}
+sid = {arm: m.site(arm+'/gripper').id for arm in arms}
+R0 = {arm: d.site_xmat[sid[arm]].reshape(3, 3).copy() for arm in arms}
+qseed = {arm: d.qpos[idxs[arm]].copy() for arm in arms}
+pose = {arm: d.site_xpos[sid[arm]].copy() for arm in arms}
+g = {'left': .037, 'right': .037}
+last = s.targets.copy()
+
+def ik(arm, p):
+    ind = idxs[arm]
+    seed = qseed[arm]
+    def residual(q):
+        kd.qpos[:] = d.qpos
+        kd.qpos[ind] = q
+        mj.mj_forward(m, kd)
+        actual = kd.site_xpos[sid[arm]]
+        R = kd.site_xmat[sid[arm]].reshape(3, 3)
+        rot = Rotation.from_matrix(R0[arm] @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+        return np.r_[actual-p, .12*rot, .0005*(q-seed)]
+    sol = least_squares(residual, seed, bounds=(s.lower[aidxs[arm]],s.upper[aidxs[arm]]),
+                        max_nfev=18, xtol=1e-5, ftol=1e-5, gtol=1e-5)
+    qseed[arm] = sol.x
+    return sol.x
+
+def command(pdesired, grips):
+    global last
+    qcmd = {}
+    for arm in arms:
+        qcmd[arm] = ik(arm, pdesired[arm])
+    kd.qpos[:] = d.qpos
+    for arm in arms:
+        kd.qpos[idxs[arm]] = qcmd[arm]
+    kd.qvel[:] = 0
+    mj.mj_forward(m, kd)
+    out = last.copy()
+    for arm in arms:
+        ind, ai = idxs[arm], aidxs[arm]
+        kp = m.actuator_gainprm[s._act[ai], 0]
+        out[ai] = qcmd[arm] + kd.qfrc_bias[ind]/kp
+        out[6 if arm == 'left' else 13] = grips[arm]
+    last = np.clip(out, s.lower, s.upper)
+    return s.step(last)
+
+def move(name, destination, duration, grips=None):
+    global pose, g
+    if grips is None: grips = g
+    n = int(round(duration/.02))
+    start = {arm: pose[arm].copy() for arm in arms}
+    g0 = g.copy()
+    for k in range(1, n+1):
+        f = k/n
+        blend = f*f*(3-2*f)
+        p = {arm: start[arm] + blend*(np.asarray(destination[arm])-start[arm]) for arm in arms}
+        gt = {arm: g0[arm]+blend*(grips[arm]-g0[arm]) for arm in arms}
+        r = command(p, gt)
+    pose = {arm: np.asarray(destination[arm]).copy() for arm in arms}
+    g = grips.copy()
+    st = s.state()
+    print(name, 'steps',s.steps,'check',s.check(), flush=True)
+    for arm in arms:
+        print(' ',arm,'site',np.round(st['sites'][arm+'/gripper'],4),'goal',np.round(pose[arm],4),'q',np.round(d.qpos[idxs[arm]],3),flush=True)
+    print(' socket',np.round(st['socket_pos'],4),'peg',np.round(st['peg_pos'],4),'tip',np.round(st['sites']['peg_end2'],4),flush=True)
+
+sock = s.state()['socket_pos'].copy()
+peg = s.state()['peg_pos'].copy()
+Lpick = np.array([sock[0]+.006, sock[1], .035])
+Rpick = np.array([peg[0]+.003, peg[1], .020])
+
+s.record_start()
+move('pregrasp', {'left':Lpick+[0,0,.085], 'right':Rpick+[0,0,.085]}, 3.0)
+move('descend', {'left':Lpick, 'right':Rpick}, 3.0)
+move('close', {'left':Lpick, 'right':Rpick}, 1.5, {'left':.012,'right':.002})
+move('lift', {'left':Lpick+[0,0,.10], 'right':Rpick+[0,0,.10]}, 3.0)
+A = s.record_stop()
+s.save_trajectory(A,meta={'phase':'pickup test'})
+print('replay',s.replay(A),flush=True)
*** End Patch";
